BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The untrusted data comes from a network request.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: No special conditions are needed: the untrusted value reaches the external API without any sanitization.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to send the data.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The impact stays within the application that calls the API.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The API may expose limited data when given unexpected input.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The API may change limited data when given unexpected input.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: The API may fail when given unexpected input.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
